name: animated-modal
title: Animated Modal
description: Backdrop-blurred fullscreen modal with escape, backdrop, and close-button support

changelog.summary: Added triggerLabel, title, subtitle, sections, showCloseButton, closeOnBackdrop, and closeOnEsc as public props with a working remixer panel. The originally suggested size/overlayOpacity/duration props don't exist in AnimatedModalContent (the modal has one fixed size and fade timing), so they were replaced with the props the component actually accepts.

Trigger button responsive classes corrected from max-lg to max-[1025px], matching the max-[1025px]/max-md convention used by the rest of the modal (tablet styling was switching at 1024px on the button but 1280px on the modal chrome).
